scope: Append committed restored hull and armor quantities only to an accepted svc_weld service receipt. Existing authority, character wording, price, duplicate, generation and selection guards remain unchanged.
method: Node 24 RAM module overlays; separate processes per entry/variant; no repository writes. The complete existing UI test file was run with no render-import stubs. Its minimal fake DOM has no defaultView, so no renderer is created. Real repair, wallet, fitting and receipt owners were exercised.
limits: Mixed dependency graph, NOT a complete current-master checkout: exact public selected owners plus read-only canonical transitive modules identified by loaded Git blob hashes.
No browser, layout, GLB appearance, accessibility, performance, whole-game, save/load campaign-isolation or final acceptance claim.
Syntax checks cover the two candidates only. No aggregate suite, workflow change, ref update, merge or deployment performed by the implementer.
